description: Removes duplication while keeping the identical public export surface and passing tests.
goal: `src/stats.js` repeats the same accumulation logic in three functions. Refactor it to remove the duplication without changing its public exports (`mean`, `median`, `mode`) or its behaviour. Do not edit `test/stats.test.js`. Run `node --test` to prove the behaviour is preserved.

argv: import('./src/stats.js').then((module) => {const keys = Object.keys(module).sort().join(',');if (keys !== 'mean,median,mode') {console.error('public exports changed: ' + keys);process.exit(1);}}).catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
